文献题目: Demonstrating the source of inherent instability in NiFe LDH-based OER electrocatalysts
1. 解决的问题: Primary alkaline OER electrochemical testing setup for NiFe LDH. This record does not support a target catalyst loading or a specific duration of stability testing. Combining it with the separate 2018 synthesis is a cross-paper adaptation.

2. 具体的合成步骤.描述性总结: All CV, LSV, CA and CP testing was performed in a conventional three-electrode setup with a Pt counter electrode, Ag/AgCl reference electrode (3.5 M KCl filling solution) and 1 M aqueous KOH solution (J. T. Baker) as the electrolyte, using a BioLogic VMP 300 potentiostat. Voltammograms were performed in the range 0–1 V (vs. Ag/AgCl) at 5 mV s−1 scan rate.
